why: clean cuts the payload out of the file on disk, and the commit that carried it is still there: one git restore undoes the cut. clean now reads each repository's history and says so, so the run still exits 2. It reads git and never changes it: the cut file is the only change, and nothing under .git is touched (ADR-0031, ADR-0068).

findings.match: the payload is in this repository's git history
